purpose: Catalogue named published contrasts while separating binding, direct structural assembly/incorporation and conditional functional infection
curation_context: Sources and qualitative outcomes were already visible during case selection. This is a small retrospective evidence catalogue, not a blinded test, comprehensive review or unbiased estimate of success rates.
verification: Primary main text and figure captions re-read; no image-derived measurements or uninspected supplementary panels treated as direct observations. Independent human figure/identity review remains pending.

outcome_semantics.positive: Reported observation for the stated endpoint in the stated experimental context
outcome_semantics.negative: Reported non-detection or lack of the stated endpoint in that experiment; not absolute biological impossibility
outcome_semantics.unknown: The selected evidence does not establish this endpoint for this exact catalogue row
outcome_semantics.direct_assembly: Requires a direct assembly/incorporation assay; plaque formation, recovered phages and structural predictions alone do not receive this label

Ando2015.locator: Results: Swapping tail fibers enables modulation of phage host range; Figure 3; referenced Figure S2
Ando2015.notes: The 13a C-terminal and full-fiber versions differ on BW25113/MG1655 despite their common donor. This supports context dependence, not a direct assembly diagnosis.
Ando2015.input_status: Constructs named in the article; exact experimental complete-genome/construct sequence mappings have not been authenticated in this catalogue. Supplementary molecular inputs were not inspected here.

Dunne2019.locator: Results: Gp15 Is the RBP of Phage PSA; Figure 1E-F; Results: Redirecting Phage Specificity; Figure 6; Table 1
Dunne2019.notes: Native GFP-gp15 binding depends on galactose. The text also reports that an Lm230-derived soluble RBP binds SV1/2 cells yet corresponding viable PSA chimeras were not obtained; that statement does not identify an assembly failure. SV5/6b chimera-class binding is reported without SV6b plaques, but the exact-row binding material is unresolved without Figure S4C.
Dunne2019.input_status: Named proteins/chimeras and source figures available; full tagged-protein and exact phage-construct inputs not authenticated here. Supplementary figures/tables referenced by the article were not independently inspected. PDF extraction renders the deletion symbol as D; catalogue names use delta.

OgariYehl2025_2026.locator: Results: Engineering T7 to display antigen from the tail fiber; Figure 3B-C; Figure 4; Resource availability
OgariYehl2025_2026.notes: The T7-fiber construct supports plaques on a permissive complementation host but not the tested nanobody-display host; a T3-fiber hybrid supports the latter. The authors infer assembly from permissive-host plaques; this catalogue retains direct assembly as unknown. AlphaFold comparison did not explain the observed contrast.
OgariYehl2025_2026.input_status: Named complemented deletion-phage configurations available in text; no matched complete genome, complementation plasmid and engineered-host input bundle authenticated. Sequencing/raw materials are described as available on request rather than identified here by a verified public construct accession.

usage_constraints: Catalogue records are not independent replicates; group by publication, construct family and contrast before any future model evaluation.
No row is selected for fitting, calibration, held-out scoring or training a compatibility classifier. Roles and molecular inputs must be authenticated and frozen first.
Do not replace unknown assembly/binding outcomes with labels inferred from plaque formation, construct recovery, structure confidence or binder-design success rates.
Listeria observations provide cross-system conceptual evidence, not gp17 calibration or High School material authorization.
Keep the existing ten-case host benchmark and its four exact-construct abstentions unchanged.
decision: Useful source-catalogue start; HOLD for assembly-specific predictor calibration because no direct assembly-labelled cases or authenticated molecular input set have been established here
